description: Bitcoin fee estimate: current fee rates in sat/vB for next-block, half-hour, one-hour and economy confirmation, what a typical payment costs in sats, mempool size and pending fees, and the latest block height, from mempool.space. No input needed. Use before sending a Bitcoin transaction or to decide whether to wait for lower fees. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
